header-text: Select a topic to create a Capsule
sub-header-text:
Capsules are a set of questions you ask other people about a
specific topic you are knowledgeable or interested in.

modal.title: Please confirm the creation of a new capsule.
modal.text: You have selected the topic of {{skill}}. If you proceed, you can create a series of questions for clients to answer in order to save time and gain an overview of the case. In the end, you can choose whether all WCR members via Get help can access this capsule, only in your NGO via their Org Page, or if it will be displayed only on your Personal Public Profile.
